this is still one of the best resources for the odd nights.

this laylatul qadr booklet has:

> preparation beforehand
> acts of worship to do
> du'a & dhikr examples
> guide specifically for sisters (if you can’t pray)
> common pitfalls

imagine a muslim fitbit to track spiritual growth:

a ring that passively tracks salah, taps for adhkar, integrates quran recitation tracking (tarteel api?), and features a mic + action button to record reflections

pair it with an ai-powered journaling app for spiritual insights
